summary.text: One of the earthborn Giants whom Dionysus killed with a thyrsus in the Gigantomachy.

story.text: Apollodorus names Eurytus among the Giants whom Dionysus killed with a thyrsus when the gods, aided by Heracles, destroyed the earthborn brood. The collective node `gigantes` holds the war as a whole; this node is the individual named in the battle roll.
The atlas keeps this Eurytus distinct from the Oechalian king `eurytus-oechalia`, the Epeian `eurytus-epeian`, and the Argonaut `eurytus-hermes` — homonyms who share only the name.
